=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:228-232 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The stale-path check now makes a fourth extra GET for a PR with up to 100 files: two compare reads, one file-list read, and the new PR-head re-read.
  WHY: Every accepted stale check goes over the issue's cap of "at most 3 extra GETs". Final CI runs this check in many jobs, so the extra read repeats and uses shared GitHub API capacity. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:159-164 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The workflow does not pass `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` to the script (see also scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:353-355), so the script falls back to its default `true`. The same omission is in the other nine verification steps.
  WHY: Final-CI runs keep accepting eligible stale merge refs even when an operator sets the documented switch to `false`. The README also says no repository variable is passed. Rated MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "API budget (§15), documented in the script header: at most 3 extra GETs, only on the stale path, and none on the fresh path." (linked issue #9688, Change item 4)
  expected_change_site: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh, `ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only`, the GET 4 block at lines 228-232
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The GET 4 block calls `sync_live_head="$(ci_final_merge_ref_pull '.head.sha // ""' 2>/dev/null)"` after the file-list loop. A stale-path accept for a PR of up to 100 files now costs 4 GETs (2 compares + 1 file-list + 1 head re-read). The script header (scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:72-80), the README env-var row, the changelog fragment and the agents fragment were rewritten to say "4 for a PR of up to 100 files, at most 33" instead of keeping the cap. Pagination above 100 files was already an accepted exception, but nothing in the issue requires the head re-read, and it runs on every stale-path run. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 3, documented contract drift with no runtime failure). minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR (confidence 5). z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not flag it, citing acceptance in the previous editor round.
- requirement: "A switch controls this (`CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED`, on by default, parsed like `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED`)."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, the ten "Verify the final-CI merge ref is current" step environment blocks (e.g. .github/workflows/ci.yml:2451-2478 and .github/workflows/ci.yml:4623-4650)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Those blocks pass `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED` as `${{ vars.CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED || 'true' }}` but none of the ten passes the new switch. The script defaults the unset switch to `true`, so the switch cannot be turned off from workflow config. The README row and the agents fragment state "no repository variable is passed". test_every_final_ci_checkout_is_followed_by_the_check at tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py:230-262 does not check the new switch. The work was deferred because the `files_touched` grant excludes ci.yml. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it NIT (confidence 5). minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR (confidence 4) and openai_gpt-6-luna MAJOR (confidence 5). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly said it is not a gap, citing "Entry point: unchanged" and the files_touched grant.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "API budget (§15), documented in the script header: at most 3 extra GETs, only on the stale path, and none on the fresh path." (linked issue #9688, Change item 4)
  Expected change site: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh, `ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only`. The "GET 4" block calls `sync_live_head="$(ci_final_merge_ref_pull '.head.sha // ""' 2>/dev/null)"` after the file-list loop. The header's budget paragraph says "reads 4 endpoints … 4 for a PR of up to 100 files, at most 33".
  Evidence of absence: The last run added a fourth `GET pulls/<n>`, so even the smallest stale-path accept goes over the cap of 3. The docs were rewritten to say 4 reads (at most 33). Nothing in the issue requires the re-read. Options: keep it and record the budget change with the plan owner, or drop it and accept the narrow window. No runtime failure follows; this is drift from the stated contract.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- NOTE: ci.yml wiring of `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` is explicitly NOT a gap ("Entry point: unchanged"; the files_touched grant excludes ci.yml; the parsing at lines 353-355 is implemented).
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh `ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only` file-list loop `[ "${sync_page_len}" -ge 100 ] || break`. No change is needed. The suggestion to change it to `-ge 101` would stop pagination after the first full page and must not be applied. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: API budget violation.
  WHY: The stale path makes four GETs (two compares, the paginated file list, and a final head re-read), which is more than the documented "at most 3 extra GETs".

  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, in the final CI steps.
  Evidence of absence: The workflow steps in ci.yml do not pass CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED to the script environment. This was deferred to a follow-up PR because the plan grant excluded workflow file changes.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh Line 213. Unnecessary API call when the total PR file count is an exact multiple of 100. Fix: change to [ "${sync_page_len}" -ge 101 ] || break. Estimated lines changed: 1. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

The switch cannot be turned off without editing ci.yml. test_every_final_ci_checkout_is_followed_by_the_check at tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py:230-262 does not check the new switch. "Parsed like" can be read as both a parsing rule and a wiring pattern, so the editor's reading is valid but not the only one.
